thread:
Alisa: Quick check — I have a customer call that conflicts with my RFC slot on Wed 10:00. Anyone able to swap or take my slot? @Jordana @Mike :wave:
Mike: I can take Wed 10:00 if someone can move to Thu 14:00. My calendar is free Thu afternoon. :thumbsup:
Jordana: I could swap to Thu 14:00 but prefer earlier in the day if possible. @Samir can you handle pre-read reminders if I move? :thinking_face:
Samir: Yep I can send the pre-read nudge and a TL;DR before the meeting. I'll post the checklist in #eng-docs later today. :white_check_mark:
Nora: I don't need a slot but can be backup reviewer for Alisa's RFC if needed. Also +1 to posting the short pre-read.
Alisa: Thanks all. If Mike takes mine I'll update the calendar. Mike — do you want to present the first 5 minutes and then hand back to me for Qs? :question:
Mike: Sounds good. I can do an intro and handoff. Quick note — can we reorder the agenda so the larger RFCs go first? That helps with timeboxing.
Alisa: Fine by me. Proposed agenda (short):
```
Agenda:
1) Roll call + housekeeping (2m)
2) RFC: Memory compaction change — Mike (10m)
3) RFC: Scheduling fallback policy — Alisa (15m)
4) RFC: Minor perf op — Jordana (10m)
5) Open triage / blockers (10m)
```
Jordana: That ordering works. Can we put the perf RFC before the triage? it's small and quick.
Samir: I'll send the pre-read reminder tomorrow at 09:00 PT with the doc link: https://redwood.infra/rfcs/2026/scheduling-fallback — will include 2 bullet TL;DR.
calendar-bot: Event updated — "Engineering RFC Reviews" moved: Wed 10:00 -> Thu 14:00 (organizer: Alisa).
Alisa: Great. Mike please confirm and I'll flip the calendar. I'll also add note to the agenda to keep each slot strictly to the times above. :alarm_clock:
Mike: Confirmed. I'll prepare 3 slides and a 2-line summary for the pre-read. See you all Thu.
